subject: general
question: Since 2011 the supreme court banned the manufacture, sale and use of which pesticide that cause hazardous effects to human life as well as the environment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Endosulfan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court of India banned the manufacture, sale, and use of **Endosulfan** in 2011.
 
• Endosulfan is a pesticide that has been found to have hazardous effects on human health and the environment.
 
• The ban was implemented due to concerns over its toxicity and the long-term health impacts observed in communities exposed to the chemical.
 
• Endosulfan exposure has been linked to various health issues such as neurotoxicity, endocrine disruption, and developmental abnormalities.
 
• The decision to ban Endosulfan was part of India's commitment to protecting public health and the environment from harmful substances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Endosulfan** is an organochlorine insecticide and acaricide that has been used worldwide but has been banned or restricted in many countries due to its adverse effects.
 
• The Stockholm Convention on Persistent Organic Pollutants, to which India is a signatory, also lists Endosulfan for elimination.
 
• The ban on Endosulfan in India was a significant step towards aligning with global standards for pesticide use and environmental protection.
 
• Alternatives to Endosulfan have been promoted to ensure that agricultural productivity is not adversely affected while safeguarding health and environmental standards.
